attr.title: RPG2LX - RPG Maker MV Runtime
attr.desc: 1:1 RPG Maker MV runtime for PortMaster: executes unmodified MV corescripts and plugins via QuickJS with GPU-accelerated SDL2 Tilemap/Sprite/Window rendering, TrueType GameFont typography, and Ogg/.rpgmvo audio.
attr.inst: Copy each complete RPG Maker MV game into its own folder inside ports/rpg2lx/games/. Direct projects and projects inside www/ are detected. Saves (.rpgsave) and settings are kept isolated outside game assets.
